sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers received some encouraging news Thursday as they continued preparations for their Week 11 matchup against the Detroit Lions. After missing Wednesday’s practice, quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot/right thumb) returned to the practice field Thursday as a limited participant.
